title: Women With Cancer: An Exercise Study to Promote Health
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate the effect of an aerobic-resistance exercise program compared to a home based physical activity program on bone mass, body composition, metabolic risk factors and cardiovascular fitness in women with cancer who have completed therapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female
* Cancer diagnosis
* Postmenopausal

Exclusion Criteria:

* Health condition contraindication to moderate physical activity
